24526.d: Sophanem, often referred to as the "City of the Dead," is a settlement located in the southernmost reaches of the known Kharidian Desert.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Access to Sophanem requires partial completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper.
• After starting Icthlarin's Little Helper, enter the small cave near the Wanderer's tent, north of the city.
• Pharaoh's sceptre teleport to Jalsavrah Pyramid. Exit the pyramid.
• Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport brings players just south of Sophanem
• Magic carpet network to Sophanem
• Menaphos lodestone teleport, then run east across the bridge to Sophanem (requires completion of The Jack of Spades and Contact!)
• Elder divination outfit teleport to the luminous wisp colony
• Master camouflage outfit Pyramid Plunder teleport
• Leela's favour to Sophanem Slayer Dungeon, after completion of Pharaoh's Folly quest.

24527.d: The Sophanem bank is the bank in Sophanem.

24529.d: The Sophanem Dungeon consists of a series of tunnels under Sophanem which are filled with a variety of scabarite monsters.

24530.d: Sophanem guards are non-attackable keepers of order guarding the bank and market of Sophanem.

24531.d: Sophanem guards are guards who appear in the instanced variants of Menaphos, Menaphos Imperial district, and Sophanem during Eclipse of the Heart.

24532.d: The Sophanem red sandstone mine is a mine unlocked by completing the elite Desert achievements.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
• Magic carpet network
• Master camouflage outfit to Pyramid Plunder
• Pharaoh's sceptre or Sceptre of the gods to the Jalsavrah Pyramid
• Lodestone Network to Menaphos, cross the bridge, and exit the eastern gate
• Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport to the dungeon, then exit the eastern gate
• Mask of dust (or its transformed variant) to the entrance of Sophanem Slayer Dungeon, assuming that the player has level 97 Slayer.
• Skill portal in Max Guild garden if attuned to the luminous wisp colony in Sophanem, head north past the altar, cross agility shortcut on wall to reach the rock.

24533.d: The Sophanem Slayer Dungeon is a dungeon located in south-west Sophanem.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The dungeon is accessed via the dungeon entrance south of the temple of Icthlarin. It can be easily reached through the following methods:
• The fastest method is to use a Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet. The ability to craft them is gained upon reaching rank 4 with any of the Menaphos factions.
• Leela's favour provides unlimited teleports to the dungeon entrance.
• The Mask of dust (or its transformed variant) can provide two free teleports to the entrance each day, assuming that the player has level 97 Slayer.
• Use the Menaphos lodestone, go through the gate connecting the two cities, and run south-east. Using this method requires completion of Contact!.
• Teleport to the Luminous wisp colony south of Sophanem via the full Elder divination outfit or a skill portal in the Max garden and head north.
• Teleport to the Pyramid Plunder entrance in north Sophanem via the full Master camouflage outfit and head south.
• Take a magic carpet flight to Sophanem. Upon arrival, run south and the enter the gate.
• There are several access points to the magic carpet network, including:
• Shantay Pass to southern Pollnivneach to Sophanem
• Ring of slaying or the Slayer cape perk to Sumona in Pollnivneach and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.
• Pollnivneach tablet and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.

24539.d: The Sorcerer's Tower is a tower south of Seers' Village and north-east of East Ardougne.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The best ways to get there are:
• Manor Farm teleport.
• Home teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone and run south by south-east.
• Fairy ring code BLR to the Legends' Guild and run north.
• Combat bracelet teleport to the Ranging Guild and run east.
• A sixth-age circuit teleport to Guthix's Cave and run east.

24554.d: The soul altar is a runecrafting altar located in the Soul Rune Temple, which is used to craft soul runes from pure essence with the Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A soul talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A soul tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A soul talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Fairy ring CKQ teleports into the west side of the Menaphos Imperial district, near the fountain entrance.
• Menaphos lodestone teleport and run west (along the southside of the pyramid).
• Leela's favour to imperial district and run west (along the southside of the pyramid).

Players with tier 6 reputation in the Imperial district can access the bank chest near the entrance of the Grand Library. The Imperial district teleport tablet places the player close to the chest, allowing players to use the two in conjunction to charge the altar without the use of the Abyss or fairy rings.

First-time

The soul ruins are beneath the fountain at the westernmost point of the Imperial district. Before entering the altar for the first time, the fountain must be drained after the completion of the quest. 

This can be done by selecting the "fill" option with any of the following items or using any of the following items on the fountain:
• A soul talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A soul tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A soul talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
